title: 33 Seconds
body: Every thirty-three seconds, the fleet jumps. Every thirty-three seconds, you keep them alive.
Fly the line. Pick your upgrades. Don't overthink the eye.
inspired: Fan art inspired by Battlestar Galactica.
disclaimer: Unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the show's rights holders or anyone in the cast.
quotes: The paperwork survives. Nothing else is guaranteed.
Resurrection ships: like exes, but louder.
Every pilot thinks they're the exception. Fly anyway.
The fleet remembers every ship that almost made it.
Somewhere, Tyrol is already judging your landing.
sound: This game has sound. The tab stays quiet until you Launch.
controls: Drag or WASD to move. Space or the button fires a missile. Esc pauses.

training.note: A short sim with Tyrol. The clock stops for every lesson.
training.noteDone: The sim is always open. Run it again any time.

tiers.viperPilot: The fleet is in your hands.

manual.title: How to fly
manual.goal: Fly Starbuck's Viper. Protect the fleet from the Cylon raiders. They keep coming until you destroy the resurrection ship.

controls.detail: Space or the button. Three a cycle.
E or its button. A rare weapon that stops all attacking Cylons in their tracks. Every 3 jumps.

fight.heading: Guns
fight.text: They fire on their own. Losing your Viper costs time, not the run.

fight.heading: The jump
fight.text: 33 seconds, then the fleet jumps. Pick 1 of 3 cards. No timer.

fight.heading: The fleet
fight.text: You lose if the civilians hit zero.

fight.heading: They come back
fight.text: Raiders return until you destroy the resurrection ship. Then clear the last wave.

credits.title: Credits
credits.inspiration: Fan art inspired by Battlestar Galactica, and by the episode "33," in which the fleet jumps every thirty-three minutes.
